paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst, FP&A and Investor Relations role at Securitize. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested because the role mixes core forecasting with investor relations at a company bringing tokenized funds to large asset managers, which is a part of finance I want to learn from the inside.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and building AI powered dashboards that brought predictive metrics into planning. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and streamlined the order-to-cash process with automation, cutting the cash conversion cycle by 20%.
That maps to the forecasting, revenue bridges and dashboards on the FP&A side, and to preparing clear materials for the IR side. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
